description: Unload and remove the per-solet macOS LaunchAgent. This stops future login-time autostart but does not terminate the currently running solet. Idempotent: an already absent plist returns a successful terminal state. dry_run reports without invoking launchctl or deleting files.
embedding_description: Uninstall macOS LaunchAgent autostart for the local solet. Unloads launchd definition, removes ~/Library/LaunchAgents/local.solet.<name>.plist, leaves the running solet process alone, and returns status, verb, solet_name, label, plist_path, prior_state, last_run_at, dry_run, and message.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: AutostartResult envelope with status, verb, solet_name, label, plist_path, prior_state, last_run_at, dry_run, and message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status. On success or not_installed, surface label, plist_path, and message. Clarify that this does not stop the currently running solet.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Unload and remove a macOS LaunchAgent for solet autostart.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Failures usually indicate launchctl refusal or filesystem permission errors while removing the plist.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Inspect launchctl output and file permissions under ~/Library/LaunchAgents. Retry after correcting ownership or removing stale files manually.
